R2Kernel Third-Party Notices

This file includes the upstream copyright and license text for third-party components
bundled in R2Kernel runtime, installer, frontend, Python wheel, and C++ SDK releases.
Exact upstream files are preserved under licenses/third-party/by-package and
licenses/third-party/rust-toolchain; the dependency inventory records their source URLs.
Build-only and user-resolved dependencies are listed in the inventory with their exclusion
reason and are not represented as bundled product components here.
Platform-provided Linux shared libraries are likewise identified separately in the inventory;
the target operating system supplies their binaries and corresponding license documents.
